blocks.text: Could you outline a small release checklist for the Studio conversation view?

items.text:
## Release checklist

Here is a practical pass for the conversation view:

- Check message spacing and readable line lengths.
- Verify links, lists, and `inline code` in both themes.
- Keep the newest reply in view when a turn finishes.

See the [Markdown guide](https://www.markdownguide.org/) for formatting details.

```ts
const ready = checks.every((check) => check.passed);
if (ready) console.log("Ready to ship");
```

blocks.text: Thanks. Can you show a reusable example with a longer line too?
What should we verify before calling this done?

items.text:
## Final checks

- Test both light and dark appearances.
- Scroll up and confirm the edge fades remain visible.
- Return to the bottom and check that the latest reply stays in view.

The `isNearBottom` helper keeps this behavior predictable. See the [Markdown guide](https://www.markdownguide.org/) for examples.

```ts
const threshold = 48;
const ready = isNearBottom(conversation, threshold);
```

Once those checks pass, the conversation is ready for review.
